name: command-watchdog
description: PreToolUse hook that supervises every Bash command, stops idle, overlong or orphaned commands, tracks real targets for wait loops, and supervises rtk's rewrite decision.

interface.shortDescription: Stop shell commands that hang, run too long, or outlive their parent.
interface.longDescription: A PreToolUse hook that wraps each shell command in a watchdog. It stops commands whose output and CPU both go flat, that run past their limit, or whose parent has exited, and it judges until/while wait loops by the processes and files they wait on. Codex loads the hook from hooks/hooks.json and must trust it before it runs.
